name: Telepathic Mindlink
body:
Telepathic Mindlink (Sp) [Doorway to the Red Star]
Source Mythic Realms pg. 9
You can expend one use of mythic power to cast sending or telepathic bond with a caster level equal to double your tier. If you take this path ability twice, you gain a permanent telepathic bond with one other creature. You can change the creature with whom you share the bond in a special ritual that takes 1 hour.
